"""RoboLab limited-mode mug reorientation episode controller.
All object placement comes from RGB and camera calibration; there is no object-state access.
"""
import json, os, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT='/app/output'
os.makedirs(OUT+'/runs', exist_ok=True)
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
obs=r.get_obs(video='none')
print('Connected. time_left_s=', obs.meta.get('time_left_s'))
print('Proprio=', obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
for cam,img in obs.last.items():
    Image.fromarray(img).save(f'{OUT}/initial_{cam}.jpg')

def ee(x,y,z,q=None,g=0, video='both', note=''):
    """Move fingertip-centre tool to env-local xyz, quaternion wxyz. Default downward orientation."""
    if q is None: q=[0.,-2**-0.5,2**-0.5,0.]
    a=np.array([[x,y,z,*q,g]],dtype=np.float32)
    res=r.submit('ee_pose', a, video=video, note=note)
    print('ACTION', note, json.dumps({k:res.meta.get(k) for k in ('step','time_left_s','done','reason','plan','clipped','control_steps_chunk')}), flush=True)
    if res.last:
      for cam,img in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(f'{OUT}/last_{cam}.jpg')
    if res.video: res.save(f'{OUT}/runs/action_{int(time.time())}')
    return res

def watch(seconds=1.0, video='both'):
    res=r.get_obs(seconds=seconds,video=video)
    print('WATCH', json.dumps({k:res.meta.get(k) for k in ('step','time_left_s','done','reason','sim_time_s')}),flush=True)
    if res.last:
      for cam,img in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(f'{OUT}/last_{cam}.jpg')
    if res.video: res.save(f'{OUT}/runs/watch_{int(time.time())}')
    return res

"""RoboLab limited-mode mug reorientation episode controller.
All object placement comes from RGB and camera calibration; there is no object-state access.
"""
import json, os, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT='/app/output'
os.makedirs(OUT+'/runs', exist_ok=True)
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
obs=r.get_obs(video='none')
print('Connected. time_left_s=', obs.meta.get('time_left_s'))
print('Proprio=', obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
for cam,img in obs.last.items():
    Image.fromarray(img).save(f'{OUT}/initial_{cam}.jpg')

def ee(x,y,z,q=None,g=0, video='both', note=''):
    """Move fingertip-centre tool to env-local xyz, quaternion wxyz. Default downward orientation."""
    if q is None: q=[0.,-2**-0.5,2**-0.5,0.]
    a=np.array([[x,y,z,*q,g]],dtype=np.float32)
    res=r.submit('ee_pose', a, video=video, note=note)
    print('ACTION', note, json.dumps({k:res.meta.get(k) for k in ('step','time_left_s','done','reason','plan','clipped','control_steps_chunk')}), flush=True)
    if res.last:
      for cam,img in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(f'{OUT}/last_{cam}.jpg')
    if res.video: res.save(f'{OUT}/runs/action_{int(time.time())}')
    return res

def watch(seconds=1.0, video='both'):
    res=r.get_obs(seconds=seconds,video=video)
    print('WATCH', json.dumps({k:res.meta.get(k) for k in ('step','time_left_s','done','reason','sim_time_s')}),flush=True)
    if res.last:
      for cam,img in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(f'{OUT}/last_{cam}.jpg')
    if res.video: res.save(f'{OUT}/runs/watch_{int(time.time())}')
    return res
